title: Reflected scalar contraction
statement: For every real $q\ge 2$, there is a real $c$ with $0<c\le 1$ such that, for every real $x$, $|1-cx|^q\le |1+x|^q-q(1+c)x$. The constant can be chosen to satisfy $c=2/5$ when $q=4$.
hypotheses_covered: The inequality holds for every $x\in\mathbb R$
replaced: For every $q\ge2$ there is $0<c\le1$, with $c=2/5$ when $q=4$, such that $|1-cz|^q\le|1+z|^q-q(1+c)z$ for every real $z$.
